pipeline_flaws: 1. Random File Splitting vs Patient Grouping: Existing pipeline split samples by individual file without group-splitting by patient ID, artificially inflating test metrics via patient acoustic signature leakage.

2. Fixed-Length 7-Second Window Mismatch: Respiratory cycle segments in Dataset V2 are 1.5 - 5 seconds, while raw ICBHI recordings are 20 seconds. Zero-padding short segments with 5+ seconds of silence distorts recurrent BiLSTM feature sequences.
3. Lack of True Two-Stage Decoupling: A single multi-class model must assign non-respiratory audio to a disease class unless filtered by hardcoded rules.
4. Absence of Dynamic Respiratory Cycle Segmentation: Long recordings contain multiple inhale/exhale cycles with silent pauses.
5. Softmax Overconfidence: Standard uncalibrated softmax assigns high probabilities to out-of-distribution inputs without temperature scaling or entropy gating.
